newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S.Africa can weather 10-15 bln rand deficit-Manuel.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa can weather 10-15 bln rand deficit-Manuel.

text.p: South Africa's economy could weather a current account deficit of between 10 and 15 billion rand in 1997, Finance Minister Trevor Manuel said on Sunday.

"I think that we could live next year with something between 10 and 15 (billion rand deficit)," Manuel told Reuters in an interview ahead of an international trade conference to be held here this week. The deficit was 12.7 billion rand in 1995.

Manuel's comments follow a survey of economists by Reuters last week in which the consensus forecast was for a current account gap of 4.63 billion rand in 1997, less than half the expected 10.13 billion deficit this year.
Manuel said the current account was likely to remain in deficit over the longer term, but that the gap would narrow.
"Part of globalisation has been the realisation that some deficit has been possible and that's likely to continue," he said.
"I think that some slowdown now would pull in that deficit somewhat," he said.
